workstreams.name: Finance and purchasing needs
workstreams.answers: What must the ERP do for finance and purchasing at the pharmacies and warehouses?
activities: Interview the staff who run finance and purchasing
Map finance and purchasing processes as they run today
List requirements from operational data and documents

workstreams.name: Inventory needs
workstreams.answers: What must the ERP do for inventory in the pharmacies and warehouses?
activities: Interview pharmacy and warehouse staff who manage stock
Map inventory handling in warehouses and pharmacies
List requirements from stock data and documents

workstreams.name: Fit-gap of current systems
workstreams.answers: Where do today's finance, purchasing and inventory systems fall short of the requirements?
activities: Compare today's systems with the requirements
Test gaps with the people who use the systems
Consolidate the requirements for sign-off

workstreams.name: ERP vendor selection
workstreams.answers: Which ERP vendors meet the approved requirements for finance, purchasing and inventory?
activities: Shortlist ERP vendors against the approved requirements
Run demonstrations with pharmacy and warehouse users
Score vendors against each requirement

workstreams.name: ERP business case
workstreams.answers: Does the business case support selecting the leading ERP vendor for Farmácias Lusas?
activities: Gather cost data from today's systems and records
Build the cost and benefit view for shortlisted vendors
Test the case with the CFO and Operations Director

workstreams.name: ERP build and testing
workstreams.answers: Can the ERP be configured and tested for finance, purchasing and inventory?
activities: Configure finance and purchasing, then inventory
Test each area with the people who will use it
Record test results for the readiness review

workstreams.name: Data migration rehearsal
workstreams.answers: Can data from today's systems be migrated and loaded into the configured ERP?
activities: Map and clean data from today's systems
Rehearse the data load and reconcile the results
Agree reconciliation checks with the CFO and IT Manager

workstreams.name: Pilot pharmacy and warehouse
workstreams.answers: Does the ERP run live and stable at the pilot pharmacy and warehouse?
activities: Confirm readiness of the pilot sites before go-live
Load live data and cut over at each pilot site
Track stability and issues with the staff using the ERP

workstreams.name: Rollout waves and run-in
workstreams.answers: Does the ERP run for finance, purchasing and inventory in all 40 pharmacies and both warehouses?
activities: Load live data and cut over each wave of sites
Roll out wave by wave and track issues with site staff
Run a month-end close with all sites live and review it
